description:
## Outcome

A versioned contract defines target names, archive names, directory layout, launcher behavior, bundled runtime rules, startup behavior, and `release.json` fields before the artifact builder is implemented.

## Work

1. Define the first targets and exact archive names from `RELEASE_PLAN.md`.
2. Define `bin/jido`, `libexec`, private OTP runtime, `LICENSE`, notices, and `release.json` layout rules.
3. Define the Windows launcher form and executable-bit rules for Unix archives.
4. Require each launcher to use only the private runtime and to preserve all user arguments and exit statuses.
5. Require each launcher to enter the CLI before it starts `:jido_cli` or dependency applications.
6. Keep exact help and version requests on the fast path with no credential check or runtime startup.
7. Require the TUI to paint and accept input before runtime startup. Permit one submitted prompt to wait and run once after ready.
8. Keep `run` and `eval` startup synchronous before work starts.
9. Define metadata fields for product, package, version, target, build, Elixir, OTP, Jidoka, daemon protocol, files, and immutable release URL.
10. Define internal file digests and the external archive checksum without a recursive checksum.
11. Add schema, archive-layout, and launcher-entry validators.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every supported target maps to exactly one target-specific archive.
- [ ] The contract forbids use of OTP from `PATH`.
- [ ] Metadata uses the single release version and protocol version sources.
- [ ] The archive is relocatable and supports paths with spaces and Unicode.
- [ ] Help and version can exit before the application starts.
- [ ] The first TUI frame can appear before runtime-ready state.
- [ ] Schema readers reject missing security and compatibility fields.
- [ ] Later Linux ARM64 can use the same contract with a new target value.

## Tests

Add metadata schema, synthetic archive-layout, and launcher-entry tests. Run `mix quality`, `mix test --cover`, and `mix docs`.

## Non-goals

Do not implement the builder in this task. Do not change the local run-artifact JSONL contract.
title: Define the isolated artifact and release metadata contract
